M-DBG-INSPECT.Purpose: Capture the live engine instance tree and its reactive properties into immutable display snapshots.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: WidgetInspector captures live children, properties and behavior parameters; DebugNode retains a weak target handle.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Generated property refs and WatchRef subscriptions supply widget update heat.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Rendering and UI state belong to M-DBG-UI and M-DBG-OVERLAY.

Requirements.REQ-001: The inspection surface is the FVPAttribute-annotated property family of any visibility: Prop, State, InheritedContext and baseline FVP. Unannotated members and fields are excluded.
Requirements.REQ-002: Property metadata is cached by concrete type. Reads and subscriptions use generated IPropertyRef slots, preserving the property's category and name.
Requirements.REQ-003: Traversal uses WidgetEngine.GetRoot and GetChildren, never the declarative Children property. Stable IDs are assigned by object identity and survive snapshot refreshes.
Requirements.REQ-004: DebugBehaviorNode exposes public parameters and an optional RefCount; null denotes a reference count unavailable through the framework API.
Requirements.REQ-005: DebugPropertyNode contains the property name, category, current value display and optional behavior snapshot; capture never mutates earlier snapshots.
Requirements.REQ-006: Observation follows IPropertyRef.Changed and WatchRef.OnUpdate across behavior replacement. Unmount and Dispose remove subscriptions; snapshots never retain live widgets strongly.
Requirements.REQ-007: Failed parameter getters are logged and displayed as unavailable without aborting other parameter reads.

Outputs.OUT-001: DebugNode tree with weak targets, stable IDs and property/behavior snapshots.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Subscribes to property events and removes those subscriptions on unmount or disposal.
